<?php
function boolReviewFallback() { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I:", $incoming, ";"; return $incoming !== "skip"; }
    public function __get(mixed $incoming) { echo "G:", $incoming, ";"; return $incoming === "yes"; }
};
$selector = "";
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo ($reader->$selector ?? boolReviewFallback()) === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_FALSE;";
$selector = "yes";
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "BAD_FULL;" : "NONEMPTY;";
echo ($reader->$selector ?? boolReviewFallback()) === true ? "TRUE;" : "BAD_TRUE;";
$selector = "skip";
echo ($reader->$selector ?? boolReviewFallback()) === 9 ? "FALLBACK;" : "BAD_FALLBACK;";
echo $selector === "skip" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
function boolReviewBadRight() { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): false {
        global $reader;
        echo "GET;";
        $reader = null;
        return 1;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-false"); }
};
$selector = "gone";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->$selector ?? boolReviewBadRight(); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getLine(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "gone" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
